warnings: Front-row vertical angle to image top 16.3 deg (>15 deg guidance [verify]).
Standing 1.80 m person on riser reaches 2.26 m; beam bottom there 2.18 m -> casts shadow when standing.
Subwoofers: est. free-field max 114.4 dB vs LFE target 115 dB; relies on low-frequency room gain (not modelled). Confirm with JBL CTA-2010 data.
Treated mid-band RT60 0.18 s is well below the ~0.26 s small-room reference: risk of an over-damped room. Trade some absorption for diffusion (e.g. rear half of side zones).
125 Hz RT60 0.42 s vs mid-band 0.18 s: add low-frequency absorption (membrane/pressure traps) beyond the 4 corner traps.
Axial mode coincidence near 62.5 Hz: [0, 0, 1] and [2, 0, 0] (L/W ratio).
Axial mode coincidence near 93.8 Hz: [0, 4, 0] and [3, 0, 0] (L/W ratio).
Axial mode coincidence near 125.0 Hz: [0, 0, 2] and [4, 0, 0] (L/W ratio).

Level: SDA-7120 (~120 W @ 6 ohm, assumed) gives est. 101.8-103.9 dB peaks at the RSP: meets reference -5 dB, not full reference. Full 105 dB + 3 dB margin needs up to 983 W/ch (free-field basis) on L, C, R, Lss, Rss, Lrs, Rrs, Ltf, Rtf, Ltr, Rtr.
